title: US monthly equity expiration (November 2027) — two sessions after the October FOMC minutes
source: EST: THE OCC'S OWN 2027 EXPIRATION CALENDAR, fetched and decoded in-session 2026-09-08 -- www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), the Options Industry Council surface this repo's opex entries already source. Its legend maps GUID 6937B1D1-F5D5-46CD-BBE7-041C7BE7B85B to 'Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date and PM settled index options cease trading', and its data array carries exactly that type on 2027-11-19, read directly rather than derived. The adjacent November 2027 rows read the way every month does and were checked before the date was trusted: 2027-11-17 carries EEF1643B ('Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date'), 2027-11-18 carries 15AA2B9D ('Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading'), 2027-11-11 is marked 'Bank holiday' and 2027-11-25 'Exchange/OCC holiday'. CORROBORATED BY THE THIRD-FRIDAY STANDARD, computed rather than assumed: 2027-11-01 is a Monday, so the Fridays of November 2027 are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th, and the third is 2027-11-19. Filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit -- a proposing sweep may not promote its own discovery, and the OCC: prefix belongs to the lane that researches this id. Discovered during the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 initial research (2026-09-08). THE HOLE IS EXACT AND MECHANICAL: this calendar carries an unbroken monthly opex series 2026-08-21 through 2027-06-17, then resumes at 2027-09-17 and 2027-10-15 -- November 2027 is absent, and it is the month a reader of the minutes ledger is sent to. WHY THIS LANE OWES IT RATHER THAN NOTICING IT: the year-earlier twin of that event, fomc-minutes-2026-11-18, put the point in its own signals list verbatim -- 'The positioning date in this window is 2026-11-20 (monthly opex, confirmed), not 2026-11-18.' The 2027 analogue of that sentence pointed at nothing, because the entry did not exist. It does now. THE CORRIDOR SHAPE, stated so the next lane does not re-derive it: the minutes release lands Wednesday 2027-11-17, the monthly VIX settlement the same session (proposed separately in this PR as vix-expiration-2027-11-17), A.M.-settled index options cease trading Thursday 2027-11-18, and this expiration closes the week Friday 2027-11-19. Four consecutive sessions, one of which is a macro release and three of which are mechanical. WHAT NOT TO CONCLUDE: nothing tradeable is claimed. The proposing lane's measurements are about minutes releases, not expirations, and its conclusions do not transfer; symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is expiration-keyed. IMPACT medium matches every other opex entry in this calendar and this lane does not re-litigate a sibling class's tier from outside it. Unlike the minutes date it proposes alongside, this date does NOT inherit the FOMC's tentative-meeting chain -- a third Friday is fixed -- so it can promote to OCC:/confirmed on its own initial research. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
